# Vectors

```{r}
squares <- (1:10) ^ 2

print(squares)
```

## Temperatures

```{r}
temps <- c(15, 18, 22, 20, 17, 25, 28, 19, 14, 21)

print(temps)
```

```{r}
temps_under_20 <- subset(temps, temps < 20)

print(temps_under_20)
```

```{r}

temps_f <- (temps_under_20 * 9/5) + 32

print(temps_f)
```

```{r}
mean_f <- mean(temps_f)

print(mean_f)
```
